title: Tactile Overload: Why Unboxing Tape Feels Maddening
caption:
Ever torn tape off a box and felt your skin crawl?
A beanie-wearing stick figure rips into his new package, then flips into full rage mode as a red 'tactile sensory overload' alarm flashes beside him.
Fingertips are packed with touch receptors, so tape's sticky tug floods your brain with signals until it overloads.
What drives you crazier on unboxing day: stubborn tape or static-clingy foam peanuts?
Save this for delivery day, and follow for more everyday body science.
